name: 曹纯

exactCharacter.y: 曹纯（170年－210年），字子和，沛国谯（今安徽亳州）人。东汉末年曹操麾下将领，曹仁之弟。曹纯是曹操部下精锐部队“虎豹骑”的统领者之一，因在平定北方的战役中颇有功绩，被加封为高陵亭侯。死后谥曰威侯。曹纯擅战，甚得人心，为人重纲纪，不失理智，好学问，敬爱学士，闻名天下。
exactCharacter.z: 曹纯前期需要一些装备牌过度使自己的技能迅速达到“最强”状态。最强状态的曹纯过牌量很大，但前期容易被针对。
exactCharacter.x: 哼哼，虎豹所至，####片甲不存。

printedSpells.o:
游戏开始时，你获得3个“损”。你失去一张装备牌后，你移去1个“损”。
出牌阶段限一次，你可以摸三张牌，并可以使用一张【杀】。然后你此阶段使用的下X张手牌时，你弃置一张牌（X为“损”数）。若如此做，此阶段结束时，若你此阶段未因“缮甲”弃置过牌或仅弃置过装备牌，你可视为使用一张无距离限制的【杀】。

versionIsolation.difference: Official page retains the older Play-start draw/discard rule; current Shanjia2025 is once-per-Play activation with 3 starting damage markers, equipment-loss reduction, optional native Slash, frozen next-X-hand-use discard obligation and ending virtual Slash.

art.description: Mounted silver-armored man with leopard-fur collar and a white tiger in the foreground; actual downloaded image inspected.

interpretations: Only current 3691 ShanJia2025 is implemented; older official Play-start draw/discard text is retained as a source conflict, not combined. No character-specific official FAQ or server verification has been established.

Printed equipment leaving the actual owner held Hand/Equipment/approved WoodenOxGrain boundary reduces one loss mark to a floor of zero. Same-owner held-zone transfers do not lose ownership; payment to Processing or a proven native alternative-cost destination counts once, its later cleanup does not. Judgment and arbitrary private/public piles do not count.

The native draw-three and optional initial requested Slash fully resolve before freezing the then-current loss count X. That initial Slash is excluded from the subsequently armed debt. Living paid activation continues to arm its negative phase obligation after source loss; an unissued optional initial Slash requires the current source. Death creates no future debt.

One actually accepted Use containing this actor/provider own actual Hand/approved grain material consumes one next-use unit and requires one legal autonomous HE discard. Multi-material conversion is one Use; zero materials, equipment-only costs and ordinary played responses do not count. Native own Dodge/Nullification true-use responses do count with exact actual paid material proof. This is a disclosed native-use interpretation without an official FAQ.

The debt is paid after genuine native card material payment and before the first target/card effect. Actual Hand-to-DrawPile alternative-cost payments are accepted only through original accepted action and native movement proof, not arbitrary similarly shaped movements.

An established actual-Play debt persists independently after source loss. Paid child movements drain once after source loss/death. End-of-Play optional Slash requires a living current source and permits only no actual skill discards or all printed equipment discards. Other unrelated discards do not pollute qualification.

Both exact skill-generated/requested Slashes use the mature extra-Slash convention: do not debit or require ordinary Play Slash quota. The initial Slash retains native range; the ending virtual Slash ignores distance. The text explicitly grants only ending distance freedom; the extra-count convention is an implementation interpretation rather than a verified server ruling.
Each inserted actual Play has its own activation quota/debt and ending. Phase expiry occurs against the exact old phase before a new phase identity, avoiding removal of a newly inserted phase debt.

The optional initial Slash reuses native draw-funded, chained-state, independent once-round cardless, faction-provider and physical elemental conversion producers. Each adapter is gated to the exact paid Shanjia activation/phase/instruction and retains the independent actual payment proof; no ordinary Play or other request is given a new waiver.

The existing private-top-basic request producer explicitly requires the responder to be outside their own turn. Its exact Shanjia request context/selected-material dispatch is connected without removing that source restriction; normal own-Play Shanjia therefore does not offer that otherwise ineligible source.
Public loss marker display is derived directly from typed ShanjiaState.LossMarks. No duplicate persistent Player.Markers counter is written.
